title: Artistic therapies (music, art, dance and theater therapy) to deal with trauma for people affected by the flood disaster in July 2021
summary:
The flood disaster in July 2021 in the Ahr Valley left lasting damage: 15,000 people were affected, including 4,000 acutely traumatized and 2,000 secondary traumatized helpers. 
In the study described here, we offer a project with artistic therapies (music therapy, art therapy, theater therapy, dance therapy) to overcome trauma as part of psychological help to people affected by the flood disaster in July 2021. The offer is valid for three age groups: children (6-12), teenagers (13-21) and adults (18+). As part of the project, those affected by the July 2021 flood disaster from the Ahrweiler and Euskirchen districts can register for music therapy, art therapy, theater therapy or dance therapy and will then be assigned to one of three sequential therapy groups.
conditions: Acutely traumatized and secondary traumatized people after the flood disaster in the Ahr Valley in 2021
